description: Dungeon Matcher UI hardware asset seed, a single small blank rectangular silver-purple dungeon HUD plaque viewed perfectly straight-on, orthographic flat 2D. Fit the entire plaque with a transparent margin within this 64x64 native canvas. Wide horizontal shape about 56 pixels wide and 30 pixels tall. Four chunky square riveted metal corner blocks, narrow straight 5-pixel metal rails between them, a quiet very dark violet recessed inset. Tiny violet socket accent in the center of the upper rail. Cool gray silver surfaces, slight purple reflected shadow, simple connected top-left highlights and bottom-right shadows, dark exposed contour. Corners are solid riveted plates, NOT diagonal diamond portrait-frame jewels. Clean modular straight rails suitable for repeating. Whimsical nostalgic dungeon fantasy; economical broad pixel clusters like the supplied rendering reference. No characters, no letters, no numerals, no text, no scenery, no background, no sparkle cloud, no painterly smoothing, no perspective, no ornate filigree. This one blank plaque is a source for separate reusable corner and rail assets.
palette_name: Dungeon Matcher cool silver violet UI

style_image.usage_description: Rattlebones is the actual primary golden rendering reference. Copy crisp outlines, economical connected material clusters and restrained top-left shading ONLY. Do not copy skeleton anatomy, face, stance, crown, cape, bone or character palette. Draw the requested blank metal UI plaque with the explicit UI material palette.
